quarterly_data.quarter: Adobe press release: Adobe and Heathrow Airport Partner to Transform the Digital (10-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Customer: Adobe and Heathrow Airport announced an extended partnership (after more than a decade working together) placing Adobe CX Enterprise at the centre of Heathrow's digital transformation; a new flagship Heathrow website built on Adobe technology (over 50 million website visitors every year) will be powered by Adobe CX Enterprise, with Adobe Experience Manager and Adobe Brand Visibility delivering personalised content optimised for AI platforms such as ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Microsoft Copilot and Perplexity AI; Heathrow will use Adobe Brand Visibility to track and improve how its content is cited across AI-powered search. The partnership aims to serve over 84.5 million annual Heathrow passengers.
quarterly_data.figure: Heathrow on Adobe CX Enterprise; over 84.5 million annual passengers; website over 50 million visitors a year
